text:
Aachen’s median asking rent sits at 11.57 €/m², up 2.6 % YoY and 24.1 % over the past five years, placing the city 18th among the 37 most expensive German markets. The asking premium over existing rents is 61 %, with a typical 60 m² apartment costing about 694 € per month.

The market remains balanced, with a vacancy rate of 1.7 % and listings staying on the market for roughly 26 days; 26 % are let within a week. Rent‑burden for two residents is 16.3 %, while the 5‑year population growth of 1.6 % adds modest pressure to affordability.

The model estimate forecasts median asking rents of 12.28 €/m² in 12 months, ranging between 11.9 €/m² and 12.59 €/m², implying a 6.1 % increase.
